description: Defines a template class TimerType with nested classes for timing and scheduling operations, including thread management and event handling, within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: TimerType
classes.description: A template class for managing timed events and scheduling, with internal thread handling.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::TimedInfo
classes.description: Holds scheduled time and content data for timer events.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::TimeWorker
classes.description: A thread class that executes the timer process.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::WatchDogType
classes.description: A thread class for watchdog timer functionality.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a timer event at a specific time with given content.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all pending timer events and stops the timer thread.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific content entry is scheduled.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers a timer event immediately with specified content.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a scheduled event with specific content.

methods.name: NextTrigger
methods.description: Returns the time of the next scheduled trigger.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending scheduled events.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the timer thread.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Internal method to process scheduled events and determine delay.

methods.name: ScheduleEntry
methods.description: Inserts a new timed info entry into the schedule.
